verdict.rationale: Orama ships both paths in the story. Its embeddings plugin generates vectors for documents at insert time and for queries at search time [orama-docs-7, orama-docs-40]. Orama Cloud automatically generates text embeddings using local models, with the embedding model selectable per collection [orama-docs-45, orama-docs-44]. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration; details on supported embedding models and providers.
